_comment: Copper Furnace (machineId vapor_furnace_mk1) steel recipe. LAVA acts as the fuel/heat source, so fuelRequired=false: the base processTick gates fuel via `requiresFuel() && recipe.isFuelRequired()`, so with fuelRequired=false it processes with NO fuel item as long as 1000 mB of lava is present in the (unfiltered) fluid tank and consumed as the fluid input. Inputs: lava (fluid) + 4 raw_iron (matching vapor_furnace_iron.json) + 4 coal. The two item input slots each stack, so 4 raw_iron in one slot + 4 coal in the other fits the furnace's 2 input slots. Output: 1 cml:steel_ingot.
